name: fix-pos-table-merge-feedback
title: Fix false POS table merge errors and missing split feedback
description: Keep successful merge/split mutations independent from all table-list refresh side effects and show accurate POS notifications.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Removed all hook-owned refetch calls from merge/split wrappers. Mutation success can no longer be converted into a UI failure by synchronous or asynchronous refresh errors. Existing POS and manager callers already refresh after success. Added regression coverage with a refetch mock that throws synchronously and verified real mutation errors still reject. Targeted Vitest and build were not run because the connected environment could not clone the repository: github.com DNS resolution failed. No GitHub CI status was attached to the commit.
